name: combined-app
description: Combined Gesture Synth Weld + Vibe DAW — agent-native gesture DAW

scripts.dev: concurrently --names gesture,vibe --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "cd gesture-synth-app && npm run dev" "cd vibe-daw && npm run dev" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:gesture && npm run typecheck:vibe
scripts.test: npm run test:gesture && npm run test:vibe
